extension.summary: Browse your Immich photos and videos
Sfoglia le foto e i video del tuo Immich
extension.description: Unofficial Immich client for Kodi. Browse the timeline, albums, favourites, people, places, tags, memories and folders, search your library, and play photos and videos straight from your Immich server.
Client Immich non ufficiale per Kodi. Sfoglia timeline, album, preferiti, persone, luoghi, tag, ricordi e cartelle, cerca nella libreria e riproduci foto e video direttamente dal tuo server Immich.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or supported by the Immich project.
extension.news: 0.1.1 - Albums list their assets again; photos open from the pictures window.
